intro: Let's guess Ken's free time! You are Ken now. Listen to my question and choose your answer.

scenarios.context: Today is Monday. School is over. Time to go home.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I watch TV in my free time.
B. I study English in my free time.
C. I play online games in my free time.
scenarios.start_place: 二水國小東側門 (school, east gate)
scenarios.on_screen_zh: Ken 放學從東側門走路回家，坐在書桌前翻英語課本準備小考。
scenarios.logic_zh: 週一放學回家，明天有英文小考，先念英文最合理。
scenarios.context_with_hints: Today is Monday. School is over. Time to go home. I have an English test tomorrow.

scenarios.context: It's Monday evening. It's rainy outside.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I watch TV in my free time.
B. I ride a bike in my free time.
C. I play basketball in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 晚上下雨，Ken 和媽媽坐在客廳沙發上看電視。
scenarios.logic_zh: 同一晚仍在家，下雨不能出門、功課寫完了，和媽媽看電視放鬆。
scenarios.context_with_hints: It's Monday evening. It's rainy. My homework is done. I sit on the sofa with Mom.

scenarios.context: Today is Tuesday. It's a cool, sunny morning. Time to go to school.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I ride a bike in my free time.
B. I watch TV in my free time.
C. I go jogging in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 清晨 Ken 穿運動鞋從家門口沿街慢跑約 370 公尺到學校東側門。
scenarios.logic_zh: 早上涼爽晴朗、穿上運動鞋，腳踏車壞了不能騎，就慢跑上學。
scenarios.context_with_hints: Today is Tuesday. It's cool and sunny. I get up at six and put on my sports shoes. Oh no, my bike is broken!

scenarios.context: It's Tuesday afternoon. School is over. It's very hot.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I listen to music in my free time.
B. I study English in my free time.
C. I play basketball in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: Ken 從學校西側走到隔壁圖書館，吹冷氣、戴上新耳機聽音樂。
scenarios.logic_zh: 人已在學校，放學很熱就近去隔壁圖書館；帶著新耳機，聽音樂最自然。
scenarios.context_with_hints: It's Tuesday afternoon. School is over. It's very hot. I go to the library next to my school. I have my new earphones.

scenarios.context: It's Tuesday evening. Time to go home.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I surf the Internet in my free time.
B. I play the recorder in my free time.
C. I play basketball in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 媽媽到圖書館接 Ken 回家，Ken 在房間拿出直笛練習吹奏。
scenarios.logic_zh: 週二傍晚回到家，明天音樂課要考試，練直笛最合理。
scenarios.context_with_hints: Mom is here. Time to go home. I have a music test tomorrow.

scenarios.context: It's Wednesday evening. It's cloudy and cold.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I watch TV in my free time.
B. I study English in my free time.
C. I play online games in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 週三晚上 Ken 在家戴耳機，用電腦和 Tom 連線玩遊戲。
scenarios.logic_zh: 放學已回家，晚上冷不出門、沒功課，朋友也在線上，一起玩線上遊戲。
scenarios.context_with_hints: It's Wednesday evening. It's cloudy and cold. No homework tonight! My friend Tom is online.

scenarios.context: Today is Thursday. It's rainy after school.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I surf the Internet in my free time.
B. I play online games in my free time.
C. I go camping in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 下雨天 Ken 在家用電腦上網，搜尋二水的照片做報告。
scenarios.logic_zh: 下雨待在家，報告需要二水的圖片，上網找資料最合理。
scenarios.context_with_hints: Today is Thursday. It's rainy after school. I have a report about Ershui. I need some pictures.

scenarios.context: Today is Saturday. It's sunny and windy.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I go jogging in my free time.
B. I ride a bike in my free time.
C. I play baseball in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 週六 Ken 牽出修好的腳踏車，迎著風從家沿街騎到二水國小找朋友。
scenarios.logic_zh: 週二壞掉的腳踏車爸爸修好了，週末晴天有風，騎車去學校找朋友。
scenarios.context_with_hints: Today is Saturday. It's sunny and windy. Dad fixes my bike for me. My friends wait for me at school.

scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I play baseball in my free time.
B. I go camping in my free time.
C. I play basketball in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: Ken 和朋友從學校騎車經過 Ken 家，往東南到水心之初大草原，在籃球架下投籃。
scenarios.logic_zh: 下午晴天適合戶外運動，草原在家的東南方順路可到；大顆橘色球就是籃球。
scenarios.context_with_hints: It's Saturday afternoon. It's sunny. My friends and I go to the big park. We have a big orange ball.

scenarios.context: It's Saturday evening. The sky is clear.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I go camping in my free time.
B. I play basketball in my free time.
C. I watch TV in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 傍晚爸媽來到草原，一家人搭帳篷、點營燈，在草原露營看星星。
scenarios.logic_zh: 週末晚上天氣晴朗，全家留在草原不回家過夜，就是露營。
scenarios.context_with_hints: It's Saturday evening. The sky is clear. Dad and Mom come to the park. We stay here tonight.

scenarios.context: Today is Sunday. It's a sunny morning.
scenarios.question: What do you do in your free time?
options: A. I play basketball in my free time.
B. I play baseball in my free time.
C. I go jogging in my free time.
scenarios.on_screen_zh: 露營隔天早上，爸爸在大草原投球，Ken 戴手套、拿新球棒擊球。
scenarios.logic_zh: 露營後人還在草原，晴天早上場地寬闊，爸爸帶來球棒和手套，打棒球最合理。
scenarios.context_with_hints: Today is Sunday. It's a sunny morning. Dad has a new bat and a glove for me.

note: 老師 11/09：情境選 B（只留星期、天氣、時間，不放明顯提示字）；context_with_hints 是原本有提示的版本
